content.title: THE MINERAL YOUR {{THYROID}} CAN'T FUNCTION WITHOUT
facts: **Iodine** (Thyroid's Best Friend) — Seaweed | Cod | Dairy Milk | Eggs
**Copper** (Energy Converter) — Beef Liver | Cashew Butter | Lentils | Shiitake Mushrooms
**Manganese** (Bone Builder) — Mussels | Brown Rice | Pineapple | Hazelnuts
**Potassium** (Blood Pressure Tamer) — Sweet Potato | White Beans | Coconut Water | Dried Apricots
**Selenium** (Cell Defender) — Brazil Nuts | Tuna | Turkey | Brown Rice
**Zinc** (Wound Healer) — Oysters | Pumpkin Hummus | Chickpeas | Beef
**Calcium** (Nerve Signal Sender) — Sardine Bones | Kale | Tahini | Fortified Tofu

caption:
Your thyroid runs almost entirely on iodine — without enough of it, the gland can't produce the hormones that control your metabolism, so even perfect eating habits can feel like they're not working. Copper quietly works alongside iron to help your red blood cells carry oxygen efficiently, which is why low copper can leave you feeling drained even when your iron levels look fine. And selenium acts like a shield inside your cells, helping neutralize the oxidative stress that builds up from everyday life, stress, and poor sleep. Everyone's body is different, so it's worth paying attention to how you personally respond.
